scope: Holistic architectural-clay source fidelity, topology, complete envelope, openings, optical room depth, program, contacts, circulation, evidence cameras, phone comparison, and delivery provenance; not textured keeper review

verification.render_provenance: Exact optimized GLB reimport named in build report; review applies only to the inspected hashed files
verification.bounds_check: Independently inspected GLB POSITION accessor extents and all eleven untransformed mesh nodes; glTF Y-up extents converted to authoring Z-up agree with reported native envelope.

prior_blocker_closures.finding: Continuous tall outer battens span the stacked side balconies, with clear screen gaps, connected floor edges, guarded end returns, and occupied depth behind. Enlarged floor/guard assembly reaches both tall glazed doors at each level.
Front corner and aerial now show the source-visible right side, exposing the loggia corner and side screen in the same elevation roles as the locked source.
Native dimensions now equal complete delivered bounds, including the asymmetric balcony projection; design estimates remain separately labeled and bottom-center offset is explicit.
Substantial continuous central earth pier and wider right bay restore source facade hierarchy. Both close views show clean full-depth pier returns without the reported v002 overlapping-face defect.
Reduced stratum contrast preserves a unified earth mass; bands no longer dominate the building as high-contrast applied striping.

holistic_findings: Three occupied storeys, deep rectangular plan, asymmetric paired front loggias, recessed right ground entrance, and side balcony enclosure retain the locked variant identity.
Front loggia walls and parapets terminate at real openings; floors, posts, beams and roof have visible positive contact.
Shallow roof is continuously closed beneath its transverse framing, bounded by metal perimeter and longitudinal spine, with no open pergola or detached roof parts.
Both sides and rear retain closed walls, coherent floor datums and physical recessed openings; no blank secondary envelope failure was observed.
Front and side glass reveals enclosed occupied room depth; glass close shows independent pane, frame, return, room, floor and furniture layers.
Whole-building views retain complete grade-to-roof extents and neutral safety margin; family contact views and both 1080x1920 phone boards were examined.
No new visible P0 or P1 regression was found after the finite corrections.
limitations: Exact source is detached_contemporary_infill variant_3 / detached_infill_rammed_earth; this review does not generalize to siblings.
Metric dimensions and unobserved rear/left elevations and interiors remain architectural inferences, not surveyed facts.
Secondary fine roof framing and material morphology are simplified for texture-free architectural clay.
Catalogue images remain selection/render-conditioning authority; clay preview does not replace them.

Use fixed native geometry and complete recorded envelope with its origin offset. This review does not authorize arbitrary scaling, engineering, terrain fit, textured keeper status, or runtime activation.
A human activation decision and separate runtime integration checks remain necessary for publication.
